scope: Exact batched unsigned RNS encoding after compile-time source-level clipping and right shift, with ordinary or Montgomery output. AVX2 processes8 coefficients; existing scalar residue API and scalar batch tail remain available.
proof: Extract active_bits=min(Bits,SourceQ-Shift). The 32-bit words represent the low active_bits of floor(input/2^Shift), with the last word masked.
For each coefficient, sum the Shoup residues of word_w*2^(32w). Each is below2p; fewer than2^31 words keeps the64-bit sum below p*2^32.
Montgomery-reduce the wide sum, then multiply by R^2 for ordinary output or R^3 for Montgomery output, with R=2^32. Both reductions are exact modulo p and canonicalized.

checks.input: Unaligned coefficient slices; random full448-bit representatives, zero, all ones, top storage bit.
checks.oracle: Boost arbitrary-precision shifted/masked values reduced modulo each prime; Montgomery output compared to independently tested scalar Montgomery encoding.
